overview: Heed the call of adventure and enter Dimension 20 where Game Master Brennan Lee Mulligan, joined by comedians and pro gamers, blends comedy with tabletop RPGs.

seasons.name: Fantasy High
seasons.overview: Welcome to the land of dragons, wizards - and guidance counselors? Game Master Brennan Lee Mulligan presents CollegeHumor's very first RPG with an '80s twist.

seasons.name: Escape from the Bloodkeep
seasons.overview: Game Master Brennan Lee Mulligan returns to Dimension 20 for an evil side quest, and this time, the villains are the heroes. Featuring an all-new cast full of familiar faces, Escape From The Bloodkeep proves that being bad can be very, very good.

seasons.name: The Unsleeping City
seasons.overview: Dimension 20 returns with a new epic adventure set in New York City, city of dreams, talking rats, and pixie mobsters.

seasons.name: Tiny Heist
seasons.overview: A world of big crimes... and small people. Join GM Brennan Lee Mulligan as he welcomes a slew of new players to Dimension 20 to pull off one last job: Griffin McElroy, Travis McElroy, Justin McElroy, Clint McElroy, Lily Du, and Jessica Ross!

seasons.name: A Crown of Candy
seasons.overview: It's DnD meets NYC with an epic new adventure set in New York City - city of dreams, talking rats, pixie mobsters, and Stephen Sondheim.

seasons.name: Pirates of Leviathan
seasons.overview: It's a pirate's life for everyone in this RPG sidequest! Follow along as a group of buccaneer buddies cause all kinds of mayhem in the name of saving the floating city of Leviathan!

seasons.name: Fantasy High: Sophomore Year
seasons.overview: Brennan Lee Mulligan and The Bad Kids return to Aguefort Adventuring Academy for sophomore year, in a new LIVE chapter full of magic, fantasy, and teen angst.

seasons.name: The Unsleeping City: Chapter 2
seasons.overview: In this sequel campaign to The Unsleeping City, the champions of New York are called upon once again to defend both the waking world and the borough of dreams from the greatest danger of all - unfettered capitalism.

seasons.name: Mice & Murder
seasons.overview: This Dimension 20 Side Quest follows a selection of critters who find themselves involved in solving a murder that occurs during a party they're attending.

seasons.name: Misfits and Magic
seasons.overview: Misfits and Magic takes place in a world not unlike our own - with the exception that there’s a secret underground society of wizards operating unbeknownst to the non-magic world. And a prominent British wizarding school is about to recruit 4 unlikely American teens to be ushered into their world - a decision they may soon regret.

seasons.name: The Seven
seasons.overview: A story of the seven high schoolers once taken prisoner by the villains of Fantasy High: Freshman Year, but now a full-fledged adventuring party unto themselves. These heroic high schoolers are facing the greatest threat they've ever encountered...graduation. Also, the end of the world.

seasons.name: Shriek Week
seasons.overview: Four monstrous students at Bram University face off against hormones, mysteries, and the most epic party in monster history.

seasons.name: A Starstruck Odyssey
seasons.overview: It's a tough galaxy out there, but somebody's gotta live in it...it might as well be you.

seasons.name: Coffin Run
seasons.overview: GM Jasmine Bhullar weaves a tale as old as many lifetimes, in the gloomy land of Transylvania

seasons.name: A Court of Fey & Flowers
seasons.overview: GM Aabria Iyengar and her pack of pixies prepare for the most magical event of the season.

seasons.name: Neverafter
seasons.overview: In the world of the Neverafter, not all fairy tales have happy endings.

seasons.name: The Ravening War
seasons.overview: In an age before A Crown of Candy, the seeds of conflict began to take root - and soon, all of Calorum was enveloped in The Ravening War.

seasons.name: Dungeons and Drag Queens
seasons.overview: Four drag queen adventurers death drop into the underworld.

seasons.name: Mentopolis
seasons.overview: Welcome to Mentopolis - the city that exists only in your mind.

seasons.name: Burrow's End
seasons.overview: A family of stoats must sacrifice everything to survive in a harsh, cruel world.

seasons.name: Fantasy High: Junior Year
seasons.overview: The Bad Kids return for a new year at the Aguefort Adventuring Academy - filled with new challenges, new enemies, and new allies.

seasons.name: Never Stop Blowing Up
seasons.overview: Six nobodies are about to step into the spotlight and reload all the action.

seasons.name: Misfits and Magic Season 2
seasons.overview: The winds of change are in the air.

seasons.name: Dungeons and Drag Queens Season 2
seasons.overview: The questing queens are BACK!

seasons.name: Titan Takedown
seasons.overview: Join Game Master Brennan Lee Mulligan and our cast of WWE Superstars (Xavier Woods, Bayley, Kofi Kingston, and Chelsea Green) in a mash-up of Greek mythology and pro wrestling! Who will emerge victorious in the TITAN TAKEDOWN?

seasons.name: Cloudward, Ho!
seasons.overview: In a world of machine wonder, six explorers set out to search for new lands and wild adventure.

seasons.name: Gladlands
seasons.overview: In an apocalyptic world, a team of do-gooders seek to put a little hospitality in the inhospitable.

seasons.name: D20 on a Bus: Season 2
seasons.overview: Dragon Master Katie Marovitch is back for D20: On a Bus S2 — along with her people: Aabria Iyengar, Jasmine Bhullar, Brennan Lee Mulligan, & Mark Mercer!

seasons.name: City Council of Darkness
seasons.overview: A coterie of misfit vampires establish dominion over a small, quaint town.

seasons.name: Toylight
seasons.overview: A band of toys rise to defend the enchanted Toylight, the last flicker of a child's imagination.
